name: car_sedan
source: racing_game-owned variant of external/physics_sim's data/vehicles/car_sedan.json (physics_sim is read-only from this repo - see racing_game's CLAUDE.md - so this file is a full copy, not an override/patch). Owner request (2026-09-27, coordinator brief 'engine30'): 'Beef the engine up a bit, maybe make it a 3.0L.' EVERY field below is byte-identical to physics_sim's car_sedan.json (same geometry/mass/tyres/brakes/gearbox/steering/aero/controllers - see that file's own 'source' field for the full derivation of all of it, not repeated here) EXCEPT: (1) the wheel tyre / gearbox powertrain-component refs, which now point back into external/physics_sim/data/... (this file resolves refs relative to ITS OWN directory, data/vehicles/ - vehicle_io.cpp's resolve_component_ref - two levels up from here, not one, since this file lives in racing_game/data/vehicles/ rather than physics_sim/data/vehicles/); (2) the engine component, now data/engines/n52b30_3l_na.json (racing_game-owned, this repo's own directory, one level up - see that file's own 'source' field for the full engine derivation/citations) instead of physics_sim's i4_2l_na.json; (3) the clutch capacity, raised to fit the bigger engine's peak torque. Clutch: kinetic capacity_nm 300.0 -> 450.0, static_factor UNCHANGED at 1.15 (static capacity 517.5 N*m) - same 1.5x-kinetic-over-peak-engine-torque convention the original file itself documents ('kinetic capacity 300 N*m = 1.5 x engine peak torque (typical passenger-car reserve 1.3-1.8)'): the new engine's own peak WOT torque is 300 N*m (n52b30_3l_na.json's plateau), so 300*1.5=450 kinetic, 450*1.15=517.5 static = 1.725x peak, comfortably above the 'clutch static capacity >= 1.2x engine peak torque' floor tests/unit/test_vehicle_data.cpp checks. Everything else - gearbox ratios, differential, TCU/auto-clutch/auto-blip tuning, brakes, suspension, tyres, steering, aero, mass (set outside this file, rg::SessionConfig::chassis_mass_kg, untouched) - is deliberately UNCHANGED (owner ruling, this brief: 'Don't overthink: test ONLY the clutch... There is no launch, stall, top-speed or other test; the owner finds anything else by driving'). Wheelspin under the bigger engine is EXPECTED and explicitly not to be tuned away (owner ruling, same brief: 'Wheelspin is allowed. Do not tune it away, and do not gate or test on it.').
